name: fix_go_context_cancellation
description: Makes a worker loop honor context cancellation with partial results
prompts: FetchAll in fetch.go is documented to stop promptly when its context is cancelled, returning the partial results gathered so far - but it never looks at ctx, so a caller with a 120ms timeout still waits for the whole list. Fix fetch.go to check ctx between items (a select on ctx.Done(), or ctx.Err() checks) so cancellation returns the partial results promptly. With an uncancelled context the full results are returned exactly as before.
